LanguageData.EEG_MedievalUnits_Desc: ON (default): Empire pawns are rebuilt as medieval troops. Their weapons, armour and clothing are replaced with Medieval Overhaul gear, and raids and visits draw on medieval squads. OFF: the Empire keeps its vanilla units and squads, for playthroughs that reach the industrial era.
LanguageData.EEG_RoyaltyTitle_Desc: Replaces royal title furniture requirements with Medieval Overhaul items. When ACTIVE: comprehensive medieval integration for all titles. When INACTIVE: medieval items added as supplementary options to vanilla requirements.
LanguageData.EEG_RoyaltyTrader_Desc: When ACTIVE: Replace Empire trader stocks with Medieval Overhaul goods (no orbital trader; guarded caravan). When INACTIVE: Add Medieval goods to vanilla Empire traders.
LanguageData.EEG_RoyalPermits_Desc: Leave unticked (default) for the medieval rework: orbital strikes, orbital salvos and food drops are removed, labourer permits call medieval pawns, and a mercenary permit is added. Tick the box to switch that rework off and keep the permits exactly as Royalty ships them.
LanguageData.MOR_OpenWiki_Desc: Lists what every Empire rank needs, read from the defs loaded in this game. Each entry can open RimWorld’s own info card for that title.
